kjv.text: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.

bsb.text: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

web.text: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.

leads.kjv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

flow.say: Henry shows what God promises to those who honor the sabbath: delight in him, honor, and provision.
When we find joy in serving God, that joy grows deeper and more real.
God lifts us above the world's pull so we can travel toward heaven without being held back by it.
God feeds us now with the hope and foretaste of the blessings he has promised.

morning.say: Carry into today the certainty that God's promises are sure and will not fail.
morning.phrase: what his mouth has spoken his hand will give
